steps.text: Bring a rope, and key 4601 for the bear room door (or a pick to get the key on the way).
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope. Key 4601 to bear room, or a Pick to get it.

steps.text: Go down the stairs in the abandoned building north of Rookgaard.
steps.source: Go to the abandoned building a little north of Rookgaard and down the hole.
Go down again like it is shown on this map. There are a few Orcs here.

steps.text: Go down again (2-4 orcs, easy to outrun).
steps.source: Go down again. There are 2-4 Orcs here. It's fairly easy to out run them.

steps.text: No key 4601? Use a pick on the mud south of the small table (32148, 32109) and take the key from the chest downstairs. That room isn't on the 7.1 map: check in the game.
steps.source: To retrieve the key, use a pick on the mud floor square directly south of the big table. A hole will appear for you to go down. Downstairs is a chest with Key 4601; take it and go back up the ladder.

steps.text: Pull the lever if the stone blocks the bear room door.
steps.source: North of the big table is a switch which controls the stone which can block the door to the bear room further north. If the stone is blocking the door, remove it by using the switch.
Go through the door and kill the Bear

steps.text: Kill the bear in the room.
steps.source: Go through the door and kill the Bear, afterwards open all three boxes to get your reward.

steps.text: If someone blocked the way back: go down the sewer grate to a room with 4 spiders, then up the ladder to the south, back into the room with the minotaurs and orcs.
steps.source: If someone has blocked the way back you can use the sewer grate to go down to a room with 4 Spiders, and then up the ladder to the south in order to get back into the central room with the Minotaurs and Orcs.
